manifest.name: dsh-system-proxy
manifest.description: Use the Windows system HTTP proxy for DeepSeek Harness without TUN mode
manifest.author: Bozheng-Li

bundle.text:
# dsh bundle patch: install the enabled Windows system proxy as DSH's
# process-wide outbound HTTP policy.
#
# Fields can be overridden in $DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml:
#
# - id: system-proxy
#   config:
#     mode: manual
#     proxyUrl: http://127.0.0.1:7897
#     useWindowsBypass: true

- insert:
    - id: system-proxy
      name: dsh-system-proxy

readme.text: <div align="center">

**让 DeepSeek Harness 直接复用 Windows 系统代理。** 系统代理开启，TUN 保持关闭。模型请求、插件安装和开发工具走同一条网络路径。 [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-system-proxy) [](https://github.com/Bozheng-Li/dsh-system-proxy/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE) --- ```text Windows WinINET ──> System Proxy ──> DSH / undici / child processes │ └── TUN: not required ```

| 不用配置代理地址 | 不接管系统网络 | 安装工具同样生效 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 自动读取当前用户的 Windows HTTP 代理 | 不改路由、不创建虚拟网卡、不开放监听端口 | 模型请求、Web Search、HTTP MCP、pnpm 与 git 共用代理 |

DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** 至 **0.3.0** 之前的版本，Windows 10/11。 在「插件 → 添加插件」中输入： ```text dsh-system-proxy@0.1.1 ``` 安装完成后**完全退出并重新打开 DSH**。
命令行安装 ```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-system-proxy

readme.section: 使用桌面版自带的 CLI
readme.text:
& "D:\deepseek-harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
  plugin --profile desktop add dsh-system-proxy
```

也可以直接从 GitHub 安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:Bozheng-Li/dsh-system-proxy"
```

</details>

1. 打开代理软件的 **系统代理**
2. 保持 **TUN 关闭**
3. 重启 DSH

插件在启动时读取 Windows 当前用户的 WinINET 设置，默认不需要填写 IP 或端口。

> DSH 是运行在 Electron 中的宿主。插件覆盖 Node.js/undici 请求及 DSH 派生的子进程；Electron 自身负责的登录与更新流量不保证覆盖。

默认配置已经覆盖大多数场景： ```yaml mode: auto useWindowsBypass: true ``` 需要固定代理时，在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` 中加入： ```yaml - id: system-proxy config: mode: manual proxyUrl: http://127.0.0.1:7897
配置项与优先级 | 配置 | 说明 | | :--- | :--- | | `mode: auto` | 跟随 Windows 系统代理，默认 | | `mode: manual` | 始终使用 `proxyUrl` | | `mode: off` | 不应用插件代理 | | `useWindowsBypass` | 合并 Windows 绕过列表，默认 `true` |

优先级从高到低：显式 `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` → 插件配置 → Windows 系统代理。

PAC/WPAD 不支持。SOCKS 请填写代理软件提供的 HTTP 或 mixed 端口。

</details>

启动日志出现下面这一行，说明插件已经接管：

```text
dsh-system-proxy: using http://127.0.0.1:7897 from Windows system proxy
```

检查 Windows 设置和代理端口：

```powershell
Get-ItemProperty `
  'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' |
  Select-Object ProxyEnable, ProxyServer

如果未生效，依次确认：系统代理已开启、端口正在监听、DSH 已完全退出并重启、当前 profile 是 `desktop`、没有被显式代理环境变量覆盖。

```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-system-proxy ``` 重启 DSH。 ---

<div align="center">

**Use the Windows system proxy directly in DeepSeek Harness.** Keep the system proxy on. Keep TUN off. Model requests, plugin installs, and developer tools share one network path. [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-system-proxy) [](https://github.com/Bozheng-Li/dsh-system-proxy/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE) --- ```text Windows WinINET ──> System Proxy ──> DSH / undici / child processes │ └── TUN: not required ```

| No proxy address setup | No network takeover | Installs use the same route |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Reads the current user's Windows HTTP proxy | No routes, virtual adapters, or listening ports | Model requests, Web Search, HTTP MCP, pnpm, and git |

DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** through pre-**0.3.0**, Windows 10/11. Open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter: ```text dsh-system-proxy@0.1.1 ``` **Fully quit and reopen DSH** after installation.
Install from the CLI ```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-system-proxy

readme.section: CLI bundled with the desktop app
readme.text:
& "D:\deepseek-harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
  plugin --profile desktop add dsh-system-proxy
```

Install directly from GitHub:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:Bozheng-Li/dsh-system-proxy"
```

</details>

1. Turn on **System Proxy** in the proxy client
2. Keep **TUN off**
3. Restart DSH

The plugin reads the current user's WinINET settings at startup. No IP or port is normally needed.

> DSH runs inside Electron. The plugin covers Node.js/undici requests and DSH child processes; Electron-managed login and update traffic is not guaranteed to be covered.

The defaults cover most setups: ```yaml mode: auto useWindowsBypass: true ``` To pin a proxy, add this to `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: system-proxy config: mode: manual proxyUrl: http://127.0.0.1:7897
Options and precedence

| Option | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `mode: auto` | Follow the Windows system proxy; default |
| `mode: manual` | Always use `proxyUrl` |
| `mode: off` | Do not apply the plugin proxy |
| `useWindowsBypass` | Merge the Windows bypass list; default `true` |

Precedence: explicit `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` → plugin config → Windows system proxy.

PAC/WPAD is not supported. For SOCKS, use the proxy client's HTTP or mixed port.

</details>

A successful mount logs:

```text
dsh-system-proxy: using http://127.0.0.1:7897 from Windows system proxy
```

Inspect the Windows setting and proxy port:

```powershell
Get-ItemProperty `
  'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' |
  Select-Object ProxyEnable, ProxyServer

If it does not work, confirm that the system proxy is on, the port is listening, DSH was fully restarted, the active profile is `desktop`, and no explicit proxy environment variable overrides it.

```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-system-proxy ``` Restart DSH. ---
